description.value: Learn two cantrips and one 1st-level spell from a class list.
You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.
You have resistance to Poison damage and advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.
Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.
As a Bonus Action, gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. You can use this a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.
Gain proficiency with Calligrapher's Supplies.
Gain proficiency with three skills or tools.
You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.
You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.
You gain an Origin feat of your choice.
Gain proficiency with Calligrapher's Supplies.
